prompt: Create a polished game VFX development concept board for this existing isometric 2.5D tactical RPG. The reference image is STYLE AND SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the detailed chibi pixel-art characters, tiled stone terrain, painterly ruin setting; do not replace the game with realistic humans or a different camera. Wide landscape board, two rows of three equally large close-up battlefield panels. Top row: a small mage at left sends an actual fiery spell toward an armored enemy at right. Frame 1 concentrated incandescent core and clear curling flame tongues igniting; frame 2 a volumetric-looking orange and amber flame burst with bright hot core and defined animated flame silhouettes engulfing the target's lower torso; frame 3 dark dissipating smoke and glowing embers. Fire must look like tangible fire, not thin circles, colored lines or laser beams. Bottom row: a blond sword warrior executes a heavy physical slash on an armored enemy. Frame 1 low planted stance and sword drawn back with clear weight shift; frame 2 strong whole-body sweeping sword strike, visible curved pale sword trail tied to blade path, white hot contact spark and subtle impact dust at feet, target recoils; frame 3 follow-through pose and fading directional trail/dust. Keep character silhouettes readable, tile coordinates legible, restrained bloom, substantial effects but not screen-obscuring. No big damage numbers. Thin slate blue dividers and small ivory labels only: top labels 'FIRE / WIND-UP', 'FIRE / IMPACT', 'FIRE / DECAY'; bottom labels 'SLASH / WIND-UP', 'SLASH / CONTACT', 'SLASH / FOLLOW-THROUGH'. Small top heading 'TALES / TACTICS — VFX CONCEPT'. This is a production storyboard / concept proposal, not a screenshot of implemented changes. High quality 3:2 or wide landscape output.
